Functional Modules

Engineered With Complete Operational Modules

Everything required to coordinate frontline operators, parts inventory, accounting, and customer communication in CareCore HMS.

Patient Master & OPD Desk

Unique UHID generation, OPD token queuing, consultant scheduling, and vitals recording by triage nurses.

IPD Ward & Bed Allocation

Bed matrix across general wards, semi-private, ICU, and suites. Manage admissions, doctor visits, and discharge summaries.

Doctor E-Prescription & Notes

Fast digital prescription builder with medication dosage templates, diagnostic test recommendations, and past history view.

Central Billing & Insurance/TPA

Consolidated billing aggregating consultation fees, bed charges, nursing care, lab tests, and surgical fees with TPA claim support.

In-House Pharmacy Linkage

Direct dispatch of doctor prescriptions to the hospital pharmacy counter with automatic batch and expiry tracking.

Staff Roles & Audit Logs

Strict role-based access control protecting confidential patient health data with timestamped access logging.

End-to-End Workflow

How Information Flows From Arrival to Handover

Eliminate manual bottlenecks with an automated 5-step operational pipeline.

01

Registration & UHID

Create permanent patient UHID and issue OPD token for consulting doctor.

02

Consultation & Rx

Doctor examines patient, logs clinical notes, and prescribes medications/tests.

03

IPD Admission (If needed)

Assign ward bed, initiate nurse charts, and schedule procedures.

04

Unified Billing

Consolidate all hospital services into one transparent, itemized invoice.

05

Discharge Summary

One-click automated discharge summary with home care instructions.

Security & Role-Based Governance

Access policies can be scoped by role and workflow. The permissions needed for your team should be confirmed during product evaluation and setup.

  • Hosting and encryption controls confirmed per deployment
  • Backup and recovery arrangements defined for the selected service
  • Audit history can be scoped to relevant workflows

3 to 10-Day Implementation & Staff Onboarding

We know your business cannot stop for software upgrades. Our onboarding team provides turnkey data migration from your existing spreadsheets, hardware integration (barcode guns/printers), and live staff training.

  • Automated CSV/Excel import templates for SKU catalogs & customer databases
  • Personalized screen share training for advisors, cashiers & managers
  • Dedicated deployment manager during your first two weeks of go-live
